definition: to be easy to notice among others
description: A tulip field in the country in soft morning light. Rows and rows of white tulips fill the view, and in the middle one single bright red tulip stands taller than all the others, swaying gently in the wind with the white flowers around it. Beside the field runs a narrow canal with a small bridge and a bicycle against a railing, and in the distance the sails of a windmill turn slowly next to farmhouses and a line of tall poplar trees.

en.question: Which tulip stands out in the field?

de.answer: Die rote Tulpe sticht auf dem Feld hervor.
de.question: Welche Tulpe sticht auf dem Feld hervor?

es.answer: El tulipán rojo destaca en el campo.

fr.answer: La tulipe rouge ressort dans le champ.
